name: mls-spike
description: Phase 0 spike: MLS (RFC 9420) library measurements. Not part of the dashboard workspaces and never imported by runtime code.

scripts.openmls:wasm: cargo build --release --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path openmls/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir openmls/pkg openmls/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/openmls_spike.wasm
